title: स्नातक तहका विद्यार्थीहरूका लिखित अभिव्यक्तिमा देखिने वर्णविन्याससम्बन्धी त्रुटिहरूको अध्ययन {Study of Graphological Errors in The Written Expression of Bachelor Level Students}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख स्नातक तहमा शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्कायअन्तर्गत अनिवार्य नेपाली विषयको भाषाशिक्षणका क्रममा विद्यार्थीहरूले वर्णविन्यास सम्बन्धी के कस्ता त्रुटिहरू गर्ने गर्दछन् भन्ने समस्यामा केन्द्रित भई तयार पारिएको छ र त्रुटि विश्लेषणका क्षेत्रहरूको प्रयोगात्मक चर्चा गरिएको छ । बहुभाषिक समाजबाट उच्चशिक्षा हासिल गर्न विश्वविद्यालयमा आएका मातृभाषी र विमातृभाषी नेपाली विद्यार्थीहरूले गर्ने वर्णविन्यासगतत्रुटिको खोजी गरी भाषाशिक्षणका क्रममा त्यस्ता त्रुटिहरू कसरी कम गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने सन्दर्भमा अनुसन्धान केन्द्रित छ । त्रुटिका क्षेत्रहरू पहिचान गरी त्यसको वर्गीकरण पनि यस लेखमा गरिएको छ । प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक स्रोतबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी अध्ययनलाई अगाडि बढाइएको छ । त्रिभुवन बहुमुखी क्याम्पस पाल्पामा शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्कायको स्नातक तह प्रथम वर्षमा अध्ययनरत विद्यार्थीलाई सामग्रीका रूपमा छनोट गरी तिनीहरूमा पाइने वर्णविन्यासगत त्रुटिको अवस्था पहिचान गरी त्रुटिहरू कम गर्ने उपायहरू अबलम्वन गर्न सकिने उपायका साथमा निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । {The present research article is based on the graphical errors made by the Bachlor level students of compulsory Nepali subject under the Faculty of Education. This article has been prepared focusing on the problem and the areas of error analysis. The research focuses on how to reduce the graphological errors in the course of language learning by exploring the spelling errors made by native and non-native Nepali students who come to the university to pursue higher education from a multilingual society. Error areas are identified and classified in this article. The study has been carried out by collecting materials from primary and secondary sources. The students of Bachelor first year studying at Tribhuvan multiple campus, Palpa, have been selected as the study population and measures have been taken to reduce the errors by identifying the graphological errors found in them.}
american_english:
The present research article has been prepared with a focus on the problem of what kinds of spelling errors students make in the teaching of language in the compulsory Nepali subject under the Faculty of Education at the bachelor's level, and a practical discussion of the areas of error analysis has been provided.
The research is centered on the context of how such errors can be reduced in the course of language teaching by investigating the orthographic errors made by native-speaker and non-native-speaker Nepali students who have come to the university from a multilingual society to obtain higher education.
The areas of error have been identified, and their classification has also been carried out in this article.
The study has been taken forward by collecting material from primary and secondary sources.
Students enrolled in the first year of the bachelor's level of the Faculty of Education at Tribhuvan Multiple Campus, Palpa, were chosen as the source material, and a conclusion has been drawn, together with the measures that could be adopted to reduce the errors, by identifying the condition of the orthographic errors found among them.
british_english:
The present research paper has been prepared with a focus on the problem of what manner of spelling errors students commit in the course of language teaching in the compulsory Nepali subject within the Faculty of Education at bachelor's level, and a practical discussion of the areas of error analysis has been undertaken.
The research is centred on the matter of how such errors may be lessened in the course of language teaching, by enquiring into the orthographic errors committed by Nepali students, both mother-tongue speakers and non-mother-tongue speakers, who have come to the university from a multilingual society in order to pursue higher education.
The areas of error have been identified, and a classification of them has likewise been made in this article.
The study has been carried forward by gathering material from primary and secondary sources.
Pupils studying in the first year of the bachelor's level of the Faculty of Education at Tribhuvan Multiple Campus, Palpa, were selected as the source material, and a conclusion has been reached, together with the measures that might be taken to reduce the errors, by ascertaining the state of the orthographic errors to be found among them.
australian_english:
This research article has been put together around the problem of the sorts of spelling errors students make while language teaching is under way in the compulsory Nepali subject within the Faculty of Education at bachelor's level, and there is a practical discussion of the areas of error analysis in it.
The research looks squarely at how such errors might be cut down during language teaching, by digging into the orthographic errors made by Nepali students — mother-tongue speakers and non-mother-tongue speakers alike — who have come to the university from a multilingual society to get themselves a higher education.
The error areas have been pinned down, and they are classified in this article too.
The study moves ahead on material gathered from primary and secondary sources.
Students in the first year of the bachelor's level of the Faculty of Education at Tribhuvan Multiple Campus, Palpa, were picked as the study material, and their state of orthographic error was identified, with the measures that could be taken to reduce those errors, before a conclusion was drawn.

The research zeroes in on how those mistakes can be cut back while language is being taught, by sussing out the spelling errors made by Nepali students — mother-tongue speakers and the rest — who've come to uni from a multilingual society to get themselves a higher education.
The error areas get picked out, and they're sorted into groups in the article as well.

translator_notes: Five sentences in the source; sentence boundaries and order preserved. 'वर्णविन्यास' rendered as 'spelling/orthographic error' consistently. 'सामग्रीका रूपमा' (literally 'as material') translated as source/study material, i.e. the students serving as the study population.
